name: yee-stack
description: Yee Stack monorepo: one shared core, one package per feature (wish / ask / browser), and a host adapter for Pi and for DeepSeek Harness.
author: akirousnow

scripts.build: npm run build -w yee-stack-core && npm run build -w yee-stack-wish -w yee-stack-ask -w yee-stack-browser && npm run build -w yee-stack-dsh --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
